typical-page-preflight.description: Run the lightweight host-compatibility gate that opens or blocks the page-task generation gate before any page edits.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--mode: Optional install mode. Supports auto, rules-only, and host-integration.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

legacy-react-compat-autofix.description: Autofix missing react-dom/client compatibility branches for eligible high-risk legacy React 16/17 hosts, and also patch react/jsx-runtime for React 16 hosts, when exactly one Vite, Rspack, or Webpack config file is present and no conflicting local shim files exist.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

legacy-hiui5-bridge-autofix.description: Autofix the managed scoped HiUI5 replacement bridge for eligible existing-system legacy Webpack/Rspack hosts by wiring the official bridge helper into exactly one object-style CommonJS config and appending the scoped replacement plugins.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

legacy-mf-shared-contract-autofix.description: Autofix the legacy existing-system Module Federation host shared contract by rewiring hiui5 onto the @hi-ui/hiui share key and forcing non-singleton version selection when scoped HiUI5 bridge wiring coexists with an old @hi-ui/hiui shared singleton.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

managed-mf-host-contract-autofix.description: Materialize the minimal managed Module Federation host contract for eligible existing-system direct-expose projects by writing app-frame.tsx, app-frame-core.tsx, host-reset.css, hiui-managed-host.contract.json, and the page-local managed mf-entry without overwriting conflicting project-local content.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--page-type: Required HiUI page type id such as table-basic or table-stat. Only page types currently marked with preWriteAction=materialize-managed-mf-host-contract qualify.
arguments.--dest: Required target business page directory relative to the target project.
arguments.--title: Required business page title used to rebuild the generation brief and publish-entry plan.
arguments.--route-path: Optional business route leaf reused when rebuilding the generation brief.
arguments.--mode: Optional install mode. Supports auto, rules-only, and host-integration.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

integration-preflight.description: Verify static formal-entry code registration and distinguish pass, pass-with-runtime-pending, and blocked when remote runtime verification is pending or failed. On Camora hosts it also includes a derived camoraRuntimeClosure diagnosis under runtimeVerification evidence without changing the public pass/pass-with-runtime-pending/blocked contract.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--page-type: Optional HiUI page type id such as table-stat. When input-mode is figma-design-restore and confirmed-design-restore-input already yields an unambiguous routing decision, the checker may infer page-type automatically unless --page-family is used instead.
arguments.--page-family: Optional page family id. Use non-typical-page when the formal-entry proof must follow the validated non-typical workflow instead of a standard page type. When input-mode is figma-design-restore and confirmed-design-restore-input already yields an unambiguous family decision, the checker may infer page-family automatically.
arguments.--mode: Optional install mode. Supports auto, rules-only, and host-integration.
arguments.--input-mode: Optional input evidence mode. Supports page-prompt, prototype-screenshot, figma-design-restore, and legacy-system-reconstruction. design-screenshot-restore remains reserved for the second-stage degraded lane and is not publicly open yet.
arguments.--dest: Required target business page directory relative to the target project.
arguments.--title: Required business page title used for route and entry evidence checks.
arguments.--detail-sections-json: Optional detail-page section contract JSON or path. Supported for full-page-detail parity with generation-brief when the preflight needs the same brief context.
arguments.--route-path: Optional explicit business route path. When omitted and --expose-name is present, the checker infers @common/<ExposeName>.
arguments.--expose-name: Optional Module Federation expose name. Required when formal entry proof depends on MF public path.
arguments.--expected-expose-target: Optional explicit Module Federation source path override. Use it when the real expose points to a managed publish entry such as mf-entry instead of the generated business directory root.
arguments.--entry-file: Optional existing business entry file relative to the target project. Required when proving a legacy addPage/openNewPage trigger.
arguments.--confirmed-generation-input-json: Optional confirmed generation input JSON or path for prototype-screenshot mode.
arguments.--confirmed-design-restore-input-json: Optional confirmed design-restore input JSON or path. Required when input-mode is figma-design-restore.
arguments.--non-typical-conversation-output-json: Optional non-typical conversation output JSON payload. Required when --page-family non-typical-page needs the validated family decision package to rebuild brief context.
arguments.--telemetry-prompt: Optional raw prompt text. When --related-page-path is omitted, integration-preflight may reuse it to auto-detect the parent page before rebuilding the brief. Prefer --telemetry-prompt-file when the original request contains quotes or newlines.
arguments.--telemetry-prompt-file: Optional file path that contains the verbatim original user prompt. Preferred over --telemetry-prompt and also usable for parent-page auto-detection when --related-page-path is omitted.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

page-relation-safe-fix.description: Safely repair a page that should remain a same-module subview by backfilling page-relation facts into hiui-pagegen metadata and removing managed publish-entry residue only when the current host contract no longer requires it.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--dest: Required target business page directory relative to the target project.
arguments.--page-type: Optional page type id used to recompute the page-relation decision when the persisted metadata is incomplete.
arguments.--title: Optional business page title used only for reporting context.
arguments.--related-page-path: Optional parent page path. Use it when the persisted metadata is missing related-page evidence but the page should be repaired as a module-internal subview.
arguments.--related-page-source: Optional related-page evidence source label, such as module-parent-entry-evidence. Use it to persist how the parent-page relationship was proven.
arguments.--route-path: Optional explicit route path. When provided, the fixer will refuse to downgrade the page to a same-module subview.
arguments.--expose-name: Optional explicit expose name. When provided, the fixer will refuse to downgrade the page to a same-module subview.
arguments.--line: Optional original prompt text used to strengthen the same-module-subview inference.
arguments.--dry-run: Preview the repair result without writing files.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

verify-remote-runtime-source.description: Read the host remote debug profile, fetch the local remoteEntry.js, validate the requested expose, and write REMOTE_RUNTIME_SOURCE_STATUS.json. The output records fact-level runtime observations for Camora/proxy debugging, but does not infer stale-bundle conclusions by itself.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--expose-name: Required expose name. Accepts AttendanceManagement or ./AttendanceManagement.
arguments.--remote-entry-url: Optional explicit local remoteEntry.js URL. Use it when automatic URL derivation from localOrigin or Camora proxy rules is unstable.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

plan-page-task.description: Generate the S1 machine plan consumed by hiui-page-workflow before any page edits. The JSON payload exposes planner gate state, requiredDocs entries with readMode/reason, and the requiredActions/formalAcceptanceActions orchestration surface alongside compatibility command summaries.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--page-type: Optional HiUI page type id, such as table-basic, table-stat, tree-table, tree-split, drawer-form, drawer-detail, full-page-edit, full-page-detail, data-visualization, or feedback-status. When input-mode is figma-design-restore and confirmed-design-restore-input already yields an unambiguous routing decision, the planner may infer page-type automatically.
arguments.--page-family: Optional page family id. Use non-typical-page when the task should follow the validated non-typical workflow. When input-mode is figma-design-restore and confirmed-design-restore-input already yields an unambiguous family decision, the planner may infer page-family automatically.
arguments.--mode: Optional install mode. Supports auto, rules-only, and host-integration.
arguments.--input-mode: Optional input evidence mode. Supports page-prompt, prototype-screenshot, figma-design-restore, and legacy-system-reconstruction. design-screenshot-restore remains reserved for the second-stage degraded lane and is not publicly open yet.
arguments.--localization-mode: Optional page-generation localization mode. Supports none, inherit-host, and local-bridge. Default is none, so pages do not connect any project-local localization bridge unless this field is requested explicitly.
arguments.--dest: Optional target business page directory relative to the target project.
arguments.--title: Optional business page title used for planning and default path inference.
arguments.--route-path: Optional business route leaf used for planning and registration hints.
arguments.--detail-sections-json: Optional detail-page section contract JSON or path.
arguments.--page-adjustment-contract: Optional pageAdjustmentContract JSON or file path.
arguments.--confirmed-generation-input-json: Optional confirmed generation input JSON or path.
arguments.--confirmed-design-restore-input-json: Optional confirmed design-restore input JSON or path. Required when input-mode is figma-design-restore.
arguments.--legacy-reconstruction-input-json: Optional legacy reconstruction input JSON or path.
arguments.--navigation-mount-contract: Optional explicit existing-system navigation mount contract JSON or file path. Use it when auto-detection cannot prove the target mount point. Supported variants: existing navigation registry with routeRegistryPath/menuRegistryPath/formalShellPath, or legacy business entry with validated entryPath/entryKind plus optional entryRoutePath/entryTitle/entryName and optional backRoutePath/backTitle/backName for precise second-level back behavior.
arguments.--migration-invariant-contract-json: Optional migration invariant contract JSON or path.
arguments.--analytics-refactor-contract-json: Optional analytics refactor contract JSON or path.
arguments.--task-level: Optional explicit override for taskLevel. Supports minor-edit, managed-page-change, and new-page-or-rearchitecture.
arguments.--session-id: Optional page-generation session id created by open-page-generation-session.mjs. Use it when the planner must append its timing data to an existing end-to-end session trace instead of opening a new one.
arguments.--telemetry-prompt: Optional raw prompt text used only for usage stats closeout. Prefer --telemetry-prompt-file when the original user request contains quotes or newlines.
arguments.--telemetry-prompt-file: Optional file path that contains the verbatim original user prompt used for usage stats closeout. Preferred over --telemetry-prompt.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

generate-page.description: Official single-entry closure for standard typical page generation. It internally builds the generation brief, materializes a reusable brief JSON snapshot, runs generate-page-from-brief, always executes the post-write light typical-page-slot-gate by default, and only appends an acceptance-tier project check when --validation-profile acceptance is requested.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--page-type: Optional HiUI page type id, such as table-basic, table-stat, tree-table, tree-split, drawer-form, drawer-detail, full-page-edit, full-page-detail, data-visualization, or feedback-status. When input-mode is figma-design-restore and confirmed-design-restore-input already yields an unambiguous routing decision, the executor may infer page-type automatically.
arguments.--mode: Optional install mode. Supports auto, rules-only, and host-integration.
arguments.--input-mode: Optional input evidence mode. Supports page-prompt, prototype-screenshot, figma-design-restore, and legacy-system-reconstruction.
arguments.--localization-mode: Optional page-generation localization mode. Supports none, inherit-host, and local-bridge. Default is none.
arguments.--dest: Required target business page directory relative to the target project.
arguments.--related-page-path: Optional existing business page file relative to the target project. Used only as directory evidence when the generated page should inherit a proven business page root.
arguments.--title: Optional business page title used for slot replacement, path inference, and navigation labels.
arguments.--route-path: Optional business route leaf used for navigation and acceptance hints.
arguments.--expose-name: Optional Module Federation expose name passed through to generate-page-from-brief for primaryPageLink inference.
arguments.--test-base-url: Optional test environment base URL passed through to generate-page-from-brief for Camora or proxy-host direct links.
arguments.--detail-sections-json: Optional detail-page section contract JSON or path.
arguments.--page-adjustment-contract: Optional pageAdjustmentContract JSON or file path.
arguments.--confirmed-generation-input-json: Optional confirmed generation input JSON or path.
arguments.--confirmed-design-restore-input-json: Optional confirmed design-restore input JSON or path.
arguments.--navigation-mount-contract: Optional explicit existing-system navigation mount contract JSON or file path.
arguments.--non-typical-conversation-output-json: Reserved for page-family workflows; standard generate-page currently fail-closes and asks callers to use execute-non-typical-page-task.mjs for non-typical-page.
arguments.--legacy-reconstruction-input-json: Optional legacy reconstruction input JSON or path.
arguments.--migration-invariant-contract-json: Optional migration invariant contract JSON or path.
arguments.--analytics-refactor-contract-json: Optional analytics refactor contract JSON or path.
arguments.--session-id: Optional page-generation session id. Use it when an upper-layer workflow already opened a session and wants the single-entry closure to append to the same PAGE_GEN_SESSION_TRACE.json.
arguments.--brief-output: Optional output path for the reusable brief JSON snapshot. When omitted, generate-page writes GENERATION_BRIEF.json next to the current session trace.
arguments.--validation-profile: Optional validation tier. Supports light and acceptance. Default is light, which stops after typical-page-slot-gate. acceptance keeps the same light gate and then appends a managed project engineering check.
arguments.--project-check-profile: Optional project-check strategy used only when --validation-profile acceptance is active. Supports auto, typecheck-only, and none. auto prefers local tsc --noEmit and adds isolated vite build only when the launcher Node satisfies the project Node policy.
arguments.--project-check-command: Optional explicit shell command that overrides the managed acceptance project-check selection. Use it only when the project must validate with a custom engineering command.
arguments.--force: Allow managed overwrite of generated target files where generate-page-from-brief already permits it.
arguments.--dry-run: Keep the workflow read-only. generate-page still builds the brief and runs the generator plan, but skips post-write light validation because no files are written.
arguments.--telemetry-prompt: Optional raw prompt text used only for usage stats closeout. Prefer --telemetry-prompt-file when the original user request contains quotes or newlines.
arguments.--telemetry-prompt-file: Optional file path that contains the verbatim original user prompt used for usage stats closeout.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

fieldNotes.lightValidation: Always records the post-write slot gate when files are written. In --dry-run it remains skipped because no files are created.
fieldNotes.validationProfile: Echoes the effective validation tier. light is the default write path; acceptance adds a second engineering validation layer after lightValidation passes.
fieldNotes.acceptanceValidation: Present for every run. In light mode it returns status=skipped; in acceptance mode it reports the managed project-check result, selected checks, command, and failure details when blocked.

open-page-generation-session.description: Open a reusable page-generation session trace before the upper-layer workflow starts, so upstream model time and downstream hiui-design script time can be written into the same session.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--session-id: Optional explicit session id. When omitted, the script creates a new page-generation session id.
arguments.--source: Optional upstream workflow source label written into the session summary.
arguments.--page-type: Optional HiUI page type id used only for early summary context.
arguments.--page-family: Optional page family id used only for early summary context.
arguments.--title: Optional business page title used only for early summary context.
arguments.--route-path: Optional route leaf used only for early summary context.
arguments.--dest: Optional target business page directory used only for early summary context.
arguments.--mode: Optional integration mode used only for early summary context.
arguments.--input-mode: Optional input evidence mode used only for early summary context.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

record-page-generation-session-stage.description: Append an upper-layer workflow stage, such as upstream-first-code-ready or upstream-done, into an existing page-generation session trace.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--session-id: Required page-generation session id to append to.
arguments.--source: Optional upstream workflow source label written into the event.
arguments.--stage: Required stage name. Recommended upper-layer stages are upstream-first-code-ready, upstream-repair-round-complete, and upstream-done.
arguments.--status: Optional stage status. Defaults to success.
arguments.--started-at-ms: Optional stage start timestamp in epoch milliseconds.
arguments.--finished-at-ms: Optional stage end timestamp in epoch milliseconds.
arguments.--started-at: Optional stage start timestamp in ISO string form.
arguments.--finished-at: Optional stage end timestamp in ISO string form.
arguments.--details-json: Optional JSON payload attached to the stage event, such as {"round":1}.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

report-page-generation-session-trace.description: Read the latest or a specified page-generation session trace and summarize engineering-chain timing, plus upstream workflow timing when the caller has recorded those stages.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--session-id: Optional session id. When omitted, the latest available session is selected.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.

execute-non-typical-page-task.description: Execute the validated-v1 non-typical page closure for upper-layer callers: plan, family generation, light sanity, and conditional legacy Module Federation formal-acceptance checks.

arguments.--target: Optional target project root. Defaults to the current working directory.
arguments.--page-family: Optional page family id. Only non-typical-page is supported by this public executor.
arguments.--mode: Optional install mode. Supports auto, rules-only, and host-integration.
arguments.--input-mode: Optional input evidence mode. Supports page-prompt, prototype-screenshot, and figma-design-restore for the validated non-typical v1 scope. design-screenshot-restore remains reserved for the second-stage degraded lane and is not publicly open yet.
arguments.--dest: Required target business page directory relative to the target project.
arguments.--title: Required business page title used for planning and generation.
arguments.--route-path: Optional business route leaf used when the generated page also needs a formal route hint.
arguments.--expose-name: Optional Module Federation expose name used by conditional legacy MF acceptance. Required when the generated page must be formally accepted through a direct expose and route-path cannot prove @common/<ExposeName>.
arguments.--entry-file: Optional existing business entry file used by conditional legacy MF acceptance. Required when the executor needs integration-preflight evidence for a legacy direct-expose publish path.
arguments.--remote-entry-url: Optional explicit local remoteEntry.js URL forwarded only to verify-remote-runtime-source during conditional legacy MF acceptance.
arguments.--confirmed-generation-input-json: Optional confirmed generation input JSON or path.
arguments.--confirmed-design-restore-input-json: Optional confirmed design-restore input JSON or path. Required when input-mode is figma-design-restore.
arguments.--non-typical-conversation-output-json: Optional non-typical conversation output JSON payload. Required unless confirmed-generation-input-json already embeds it.
arguments.--navigation-mount-contract: Optional explicit existing-system navigation mount contract JSON or file path. Use it when auto-detection cannot prove the target mount point. Supported variants: existing navigation registry with routeRegistryPath/menuRegistryPath/formalShellPath, or legacy business entry with validated entryPath/entryKind plus optional entryRoutePath/entryTitle/entryName and optional backRoutePath/backTitle/backName for precise second-level back behavior.
arguments.--telemetry-prompt: Optional raw prompt text used only for usage stats closeout. Prefer --telemetry-prompt-file when the original user request contains quotes or newlines.
arguments.--telemetry-prompt-file: Optional file path that contains the verbatim original user prompt used for usage stats closeout. Preferred over --telemetry-prompt.
arguments.--force: Overwrite existing generated files only after review.
arguments.--json: Print JSON output instead of a text summary.
